220300102.text: Sorry for my impudence, but I need your help with a certain matter today.

220300106.text: After I was hired by Xudong, I have been traveling with him and the others.

220300107.text: I want to make some gifts as my token of appreciation for his taking me in.

220300108.text: But since Xudong appears to prefer cooking to martial arts, I would like to make some food personally.

220300109.text: I had already found two locations for the necessary ingredients, and I was planning to retrieve the ingredients once they have ripened.

220300110.text: However, there are two groups of monsters occupying those two locations, and they all have already taken the ingredients.

220300111.text: The freshness of the ingredients is essential for me to cook the dish. I was planning to get them from one place first and then go to the other...

220300112.text: But now that both groups of monsters have already taken the ingredients, I must retrieve those two ingredients as soon as possible if I am to cook that dish.

220300113.text: However... I can't be in two places at once. Even if I can handle the monsters at one place, the ingredients would have already been ruined by the monsters at the second.

220300114.text: That's why I need your help. We will defeat those monsters at the same time and retrieve the ingredients.

220300105.text: Since I need something from you, this sort of etiquette is necessary.

220300201.text: This is the place. The two groups of monsters have set up camp on both sides.

220300202.text: I have already snuck in there to scout. Although the monsters at the left camp appear to be weaker, there are many of them.

220300203.text: There are fewer monsters at the right camp, but they are much stronger.

220300204.text: Please eliminate the monsters at one camp and leave the other camp to me.

220300402.text: Then I shall leave it to you. I will go to the other camp.

220300404.text: They are just monsters. There is no need to worry about me. If it weren't for the ingredients, I would have been able to take them all.

220300405.text: Alright, once you have eliminated the monsters and retrieved the ingredients, you can come find me at the other camp.

220300406.text: Let's get going now. If the ingredients are ruined, I'm afraid that the dish won't be as tasty as I promised.

220300301.text: I will take care of the camp on the right.

220300302.text: Then I shall leave it to you. I will go to the other camp.

220300304.text: They are just monsters. There is no need to worry about me. If it weren't for the ingredients, I would have been able to take them all.

220300305.text: Alright, once you have eliminated the monsters and retrieved the ingredients, you can come find me at the other camp.

220300306.text: Let's get going now. If the ingredients are ruined, I'm afraid that the dish won't be as tasty as I promised.

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat all opponents in the encampment on the left
Defeat all opponents in the encampment on the right

220300601.text: Thank you! These ingredients are still usable, but we cannot delay any further... I'm going to get started with the cooking now.

220300602.text: It's done. Phew... it's all thanks to you that this dish was completed smoothly.

220300604.text: Of course. Be it floral design, tea, cooking, or swordsmanship, if you don't pursue perfection, their meaning will be lost.

220300605.text: The path of "extremes" is my way of living. However... Xudong appears to hold a different opinion.

220300606.text: He once told me that there is a word in Liyue called moderation.

220300607.text: It means one should always avoid being extreme, whether it be living one's life or doing certain things. Moderation without leaning towards either side is the best way to live.

220300608.text: I don't quite understand what Xudong meant, really.

220300609.text: But I believe that he must have gone through many things to have come up with this sort of philosophy...

220300612.text: Since we have already acquired the ingredients and finished cooking, I shan't take any more of your time.

220300613.text: Please take this, and I will bring the rest to Xudong. I'm certain he will be happy to try them.

220300611.text: I have already taken care of them. There is no need to worry.
